title.text: Michelle Kwan competing at the 2001 US National Championships

paragraphs.text: At five years old, Michelle Kwan began ice-skating lessons with her sister. After winning some skating contests, she started to train with a coach.

Each day, Michelle woke up early to practice before school. She learned to do jumps and spins on the ice. Soon, Michelle became an accomplished skater. She often earned high scores for her beautiful skating even though she was one of the youngest skaters in the contests.

It was not easy, but Michelle's hard work paid off. When she was only fifteen, Michelle won her first gold medal at the World Championships. Then she went on to win the gold four more times. This was an amazing accomplishment, since only two other Americans had done this before. She also won medals at two Olympic Winter Games.

Michelle did not always win first place. But even when other skaters won contests, Michelle was a good sport. Her fans looked up to her for how she always stayed positive, no matter whether she won or lost.
